## Summary

Describe what changed and which LAB-NNN evidence supports the change.

## Quality checklist

- [ ] Links to referenced lab documentation and evidence work.
- [ ] Observations are distinguished from hypotheses and simulation from real incidents.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private logs, or unredacted sensitive data are included.
- [ ] New technical claims are backed by reproducible steps or named evidence.
- [ ] Known limitations and incomplete work are described accurately.
